# Uiory

> Curated AI UI Components, WebGL Shaders & Verified Prompts

Uiory (https://uiory.com) is an open showcase of production-ready UI components built with frontier AI models (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro). Every component includes the exact prompt blueprint used to generate it, side-by-side builder comparisons (e.g. Muse AI vs. Claude), live interactive previews, and complete source code.

## Key Sections
- [Showcase & Component Directory](https://uiory.com/): Browse, preview, and copy prompts for 200+ interactive web components.
- [Services](https://uiory.com/services): Custom UI component engineering, WebGL shaders, design systems, and frontend consulting.
- [About](https://uiory.com/about): Mission, zero-hallucination prompt architecture, and benchmarking methodology.
- [Contact](https://uiory.com/contact): Inquiries for custom engineering and partnerships.

## Popular Categories
- **Hero Sections**: High-converting landing page headers with particle systems, 3D meshes, and ambient glow.
- **Cards & Grids**: Responsive Bento grids, 3D interactive tilt cards, and glassmorphism containers.
- **Navigation**: Floating pill navigation docks, blurred sticky headers, and accessible mobile drawers.
- **Pricing Tables**: Interactive tiered billing components, feature comparisons, and animated switches.
- **Forms & Inputs**: Polished authentication layouts, multi-step wizards, and floating label inputs.
- **Footers**: Comprehensive site footers with responsive link trees and newsletter integrations.

## Prompt Blueprint Usage
Every prompt in Uiory is engineered with:
- Visual styling guidelines (Tailwind CSS, dark mode harmonic color palette).
- Animation specifications (Framer Motion, GSAP, CSS cubic-bezier transitions).
- Zero-hallucination constraints (TypeScript types, accessible ARIA attributes).
- Model-agnostic compatibility for Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Cursor, v0, Windsurf, and ChatGPT.

## Extended Documentation
- [Full LLM Specification](https://uiory.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed component schemas, styling tokens, and prompt engineering guidelines.
